answer_1.quote: Paraphrase generation aims to generate alternative surface forms expressing the same semantic content as the original text ... we evaluate on English paraphrases generated from the WMT14 English‑French parallel corpus and the MTC Chinese‑English test set.

answer_2.quote: we use BLEU(c, r) as a measure of fidelity, and BLEU(c, s) — known as self‑BLEU — as a measure of diversity. We also report iBLEU = α BLEU – (1‑α) self‑BLEU.

answer_4.quote: We carried out a human evaluation through Amazon Mechanical Turk... we ask human evaluators to compare the two sentences according to three criteria: diversity, fidelity and fluency. ... We ask human evaluators to compare systems on three different dimensions, according to the following instructions: Meaning... Surface similarity... Fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to judge each paraphrase pair on meaning (fidelity), surface similarity (diversity) and fluency using crowd‑sourced Amazon Mechanical Turk workers.
